# Retained original resource-text operation

These inputs retain the four real Behavioral-C transfers at RVA 0x1284–0x12a7,
their header, and the ordinary resource-text candidate from the retained Metapad
v15 work package. `boundary.json` binds their exact slice, interface and source
digests, fixed image views, private stack range and selected service premises.
The runtime header and behavioral support are generated by the tests and checked
against those retained digests.

The compact functional comparison is conditional on its explicit memory/service
domain. Neither these fixtures nor passing comparisons authorize a provider.
Tests cover both the earlier terminating-output proposal and the ordinary
resource-text profile with arbitrary framed output bytes. The latter proves
alias/effect equivalence without establishing a current NUL for callers.
